tools.name: search_mechanisms
tools.description: Search the registry by name, identifier or a word in the definition, scope, boundary or test. Returns matching entries with id, name, layer, kind, review state, name_test and the first sentence of the definition. A term matches the start of a word, terms shorter than 2 characters are ignored and lis

tools.name: get_mechanism
tools.description: Read one published entry in full: definition, scope, boundary, distinguishing test, related identifiers, phase roles and status fields, with its versioned GitHub address and a citation line. Does not filter by review state; the requested identifier always returns. An unknown or retired identifier is

tools.name: resolve_name
tools.description: Turn a display name, an identifier or a retired identifier into the current identifier (for example export_pressure becomes export_earnings_shock). If nothing matches it says so and returns the closest three candidates.

tools.name: list_mechanisms
tools.description: List entries with identifier, name, layer, kind and review state, optionally by layer and review state. The default lists every entry; with review=accepted the response states how many entries in review are not shown.

tools.name: cite
tools.description: Return the recommended citation line for a version, its version DOI (if it has one), the DOI that covers all versions, and the licence.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List the published registry versions with release dates, version DOIs, entry counts and changes (kinds, the summary from CHANGELOG.md, the number of change items and a link to them). The first listed with default true is used when a version is not given.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the registry; returns results with id, title and url. A thin wrapper over search_mechanisms for connectors that expect a search and a fetch tool. It looks in all review states and marks entries in review in the title. Entries describe processes in general, not the present state of any country

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one entry by identifier as text with its url and metadata. A thin wrapper over get_mechanism for connectors that expect a search and a fetch tool. Entries describe processes in general, not the present state of any country, market or asset.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
